# Help and feedback

- [Install or update the extension](../docs/SETUP.md).
- [Understand your stats](../docs/USAGE.md).
- [Try common fixes](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).
- [Report a bug or suggest a feature](https://github.com/vibhor1102/monkeytype-local-analytics/issues/new/choose).

Include your operating system, browser/extension versions, and steps to repeat a bug. Don’t post backups, browser profiles, or account details. Crop personal information from screenshots.

For security problems, use [private reporting](../SECURITY.md).
